CMS-1500 Coder

Pick the context — get the exact claim line

Pick one or more services, providers, and (optionally) locations. The chargemaster resolves every CMS-1500 line — procedure code, modifier string, place-of-service code, units, and charge — and flags which are billable. Click any line for the full claim form.

✏️ Editing saved claim — make changes then click Update claim, or cancel to discard.

Every approved billing combination

The permutation grid is driven by the rules generated in the Setup Wizard — provider × service × place of service × telehealth × payer, limited to the rows your admin approved and priced. Filter, sort, and export to CSV.

No active chargemaster yet

Providers start unenrolled. Run the Setup Wizard to load providers, choose your places of service / encounter modes / payers, then approve and price the permutations that become your live chargemaster.

Client Roster

Patients & insurance

Demographics, primary and secondary insurance, and referring provider for each patient. Selecting a patient on the Lookup tab auto-fills CMS-1500 Boxes 1a, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11, and 17.

ID Name DOB Sex Address Practice Actions
Rendering Roster

Providers & licensure

The provider roster that fuels the permutation engine. Each provider carries one rendering license, which drives service eligibility and the discipline/level modifiers applied per payer. Seeded with 100 providers — edit licensure, deactivate, or replace the roster via the Setup Wizard.

IDNameRendering licenseLocationNPIActions
Payor Network

Payors

The payor roster the permutation engine bills against. Each payor maps to a billing class (Medicare / Medi-Cal / Commercial) that drives the rules, and carries a payer ID and mailing address. Add, edit, or replace the roster — upload a CSV/Excel and every payor is listed automatically, grouped by address state.

PayorBilling classPayer IDStateContract endActions
Master Code Catalog

Code Library & charges

The source catalog behind the lookup and the permutation engine. Edit the billed amount (and optional allowed amount) per code or deactivate codes you don't bill — these defaults seed the workbook the wizard generates.

Charges shown are illustrative placeholders — set them to your practice's billed amounts. Coverage, modifier, and place-of-service rules reflect common behavioral-health billing conventions; always confirm against each payer's current policy.
Add a CPT / HCPCS code to the catalog

Contracted Rates

Rate Table

Per-payor contracted rates by CPT code, rendering license, and place of service. Rates override the Code Library billed amount on the CMS-1500. Combos without a rate show a warning on the claim form.

Locality Management

Define Medicare payment localities and the counties they cover. Used in rate entry dropdowns and Expected Reimbursement calculations.
